newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary APV to sell remaining OTP stake.
newsitem.headline: Hungary APV to sell remaining OTP stake.

text.p: Hungary's privatisation agency APV Rt said on Wednesday it would sell the remaining 25 percent state stake in the country's largest bank, OTP Bank Rt.
"The board has approved the sale of the remaining package of 7 million ordinary shares in one combined transaction," APV said in a statement.
The combined sale will consist of a private placement for foreign and domestic instutional investors and a public offering for private domestic investors.
It added that the offering will take place after OTP has met its legal obligation to transfer one golden share to APV.
Financial advisors and lead managers for the offering will be London-based Schroders and Budapest-based Creditanstalt Ertekpapir Rt, the statement said.
Market sources told Reuters the move was likely to happen around October.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange OTP shares closed at 6,400 forints, down 400, on Wednesday.
